dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Oh, oh, what should I do...

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Ahem! Would you care to join me for a cup of coffee, good lady? If coffee is not to your taste, we can have black tea, milk tea, or hot chocolate instead.

dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: If you don't want to, that's also perfectly okay. I'll keep my distance and be with you in spirit as you enjoy a drink on your own. Your joy is my joy.
